title: Riveted floor plate
description: A full block of treaded steel with corner fasteners; tiles on a 1 × 1 grid.

title: Safety edge floor
description: A directional safety stripe marks loading bays and changes in level.

title: Poured factory concrete
description: Quiet neutral infill for large factory floors.

title: Recessed drain grate
description: An open grate set flush into a full-height concrete floor.

title: Open grated catwalk
description: A thin 1 × 1 deck with real gaps and an underside support frame.

title: Catwalk · left rail
description: Walkway with left handrail and toe board.

title: Catwalk · right rail
description: Walkway with right handrail and toe board.

title: Catwalk · both rails
description: A protected straight bridge segment.

title: Catwalk · outer corner
description: Outside railing for a right-angle landing.

title: Grated stair flight
description: Eight treads rise exactly one block over one block of run. Repeat for taller landings.

title: Safety railing
description: Independent handrail with a kick plate; rotates through four directions.

title: Bolted I-section column
description: Stackable one-block structural column with broad bolted feet.

title: I-section crossbeam
description: A one-block beam module for overhead frames and gantries.

title: Rolling loading-bay shutter
description: A 3 × 3 opening. Eleven slats retract into the overhead hood; guides and motor stay fixed.

title: Hinged catwalk safety gate
description: A one-block safety gate with an offset hinge and matching toe board.

title: Factory personnel door
description: A 1 × 2 steel door with inspection window and kick plate.

title: Floor service hatch
description: A one-block hinged maintenance cover. The whole deck pivots from its rear edge.

title: Caged freight elevator
description: Place the controller in front of a clear 3 × 3 × 7 shaft. The caged platform travels three blocks between two docks.

title: Lift guide extension
description: Two-block guide segment for elevator shaft construction.

title: Lift call panel
description: Use to link to the nearest owned freight lift within twelve blocks; calls the cab to this floor.

title: Flanged utility duct
description: One-block utility duct with matched 12-unit ports.

title: Utility duct elbow
description: A 90-degree return with the same port centers as the straight duct.

title: Louvred wall vent
description: Recessed vent cover with separate louvres.

title: Guarded factory lamp
description: Caged wall light with native light on/off states.

title: Steel cargo pallet
description: A low loading-bay prop with visible forklift pockets.

title: Foundry Workbench
description: Craft the factory block collection in dedicated Floors, Walkways, Structure, Fixtures and Mechanisms tabs.
